constraints: Two maintainers with roughly six hours a week each
No breaking changes to the existing config format for at least a year

options.label: Public plugin architecture now
options.summary: Design and ship a stable plugin API (entry points, versioned hooks) in the next release.

options.label: Stay monolithic, revisit later
options.summary: Keep the single-package design; add features in core as requested; revisit plugins after the next major version.

options.label: Internal seams now, public API later
options.summary: Refactor core into internal modules with clean boundaries this cycle, but publish no plugin API until usage patterns settle.

brief.question: Should the loglens open-source CLI adopt a public plugin architecture now, keep its monolith and add extension points later, or build internal module seams now with a public plugin API later?
brief.stakes: The choice shapes the next two years of the project: contributor growth and user workarounds on one side, maintainer load and API stability on the other.
